# 0x7C8EC0 __allmul 基准（batch 963）——64 位乘法真身模拟
# 格式: CASE a=<hex64> b=<hex64> -> ret=<hex64>
# ret = (uint64)a * b，小端无符号；溢出按 64 位回绕（a_hi*b_hi 丢弃）
CASE a=0000000000000000 b=0000000000000000 -> ret=0000000000000000
CASE a=0000000000000001 b=0000000000000001 -> ret=0000000000000001
CASE a=00000000ffffffff b=00000000ffffffff -> ret=fffffffe00000001
CASE a=8000000000000000 b=8000000000000000 -> ret=0000000000000000
CASE a=0000000100000000 b=0000000000000002 -> ret=0000000200000000
CASE a=0000000000000002 b=0000000100000000 -> ret=0000000200000000
CASE a=0000000100000000 b=0000000100000000 -> ret=0000000000000000
CASE a=123456789abcdef0 b=00000000abcdef01 -> ret=bcdf0117c50eeef0
CASE a=ffffffffffffffff b=ffffffffffffffff -> ret=0000000000000001
CASE a=00000000ffffffff b=ffffffff00000000 -> ret=0000000100000000
CASE a=deadbeefcafebabe b=1234567890abcdef -> ret=773285ae1c447d62
CASE a=0000000000000000 b=ffffffffffffffff -> ret=0000000000000000
CASE a=ffffffffffffffff b=0000000000000000 -> ret=0000000000000000
CASE a=0000000080000000 b=0000000080000000 -> ret=4000000000000000
CASE a=abcdef0123456789 b=fedcba9876543210 -> ret=2e59bccce1833a90
